authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text: SK hynix Inc. (or “the company”, www.skhynix.com) announced today that it has begun volume production of HBM3E*, the newest AI memory product with ultra-high performance, for supply to a customer from late March.
precision_guard: This establishes volume production by the March 19 announcement. 'for supply to a customer from late March' is a near-term supply timing statement; do not backdate customer supply before separate evidence establishes it occurred.
researcher_paraphrase: SK hynix said HBM3E volume production had begun and described customer supply as beginning from late March.
source_title: SK hynix Begins Volume Production of Industry’s First HBM3E
